verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions team event logs, audit logs, an activity-log API, or SIEM export. The nearest items are file-change webhooks and listing team namespaces, which are adjacent features and not auditable activity logs. Audit logging is a fair axis for a team cloud-storage product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a security engineer, activity is auditable — team event/audit logs with documented API access or SIEM export
